==================================================
State-changing empty token recovering a missing end
==================================================

a(b

---

(document
  (call
    (MISSING ")"))
  (end))

==================================================
Completed call followed by an empty end token
==================================================

a(b)

---

(document
  (call)
  (end))

==================================================
Recover a missing internal closer before an empty end
==================================================

a[b

---

(document (internal_call (MISSING "]")) (end))

==================================================
Keep an empty end after a completed internal closer
==================================================

a[b]

---

(document (internal_call) (end))
